name: Shopify Custom App
description: Shopify Custom App is a merchant-managed app distributed to one store or a bounded Plus organization, with store API access controlled by its installation, credentials and scopes.
agentUseSummary: This merchant-owned identity pattern is visible as a canonical Shopify extension preview. Relay will not collect a store token or client secret or create duplicate commerce tools beside the canonical Shopify connector.

capabilities.label: Use a merchant-managed Shopify app
capabilities.description: If customer-managed identity is approved, extend the canonical Shopify connector with an immutable shop, app, credential, scope and rotation binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Shopify provider state
blocked.description: A custom-app listing must not create a parallel shop token, tool or approval surface beside Relay's canonical Shopify connector.

blocked.label: Capture Shopify custom-app credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a merchant to paste an Admin API token, client secret or other custom-app credential into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Create or administer a Shopify custom app
blocked.description: Creating, installing, releasing, rotating, reinstalling or deleting a custom app is merchant or developer administration outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Expand Shopify store authority
blocked.description: Relay will not add orders, customers, payments, fulfilment, inventory, themes, files, billing or other broad scopes to a merchant-managed app.

blocked.label: Run Shopify actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved custom identity must reuse the canonical connector's exact shop binding, typed catalog actions, approvals and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: Shopify custom-app security review
approvalProfiles.description: This setup alias is not connectable. Merchant-owned credentials remain unavailable unless the canonical Shopify connector has a least-privilege, revocable customer-managed identity design.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; merchant-owned identity must extend the canonical Shopify provider pack.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; merchant-owned identity must extend the canonical Shopify provider pack.

providerSetup.blocker: Shopify custom apps are merchant-managed installations for one store or a bounded Plus organization. Depending on the creation path they use store access tokens or merchant-owned client credentials, and their scopes can grant broad commerce authority. Relay already has a canonical public-app connector and does not accept customer custom-app credentials.
providerSetup.nextAction: Prefer Relay-owned OAuth on the canonical Shopify connector. For an approved customer-managed case, extend that connector with immutable shop/app binding, only write_products and write_publications, encrypted credentials, token expiry or rotation, uninstall and scope-change handling, mandatory privacy controls where applicable, and the existing nine typed action policies.

evidence.supports: Shopify defines custom distribution for one store, a bounded Plus organization or development stores, and distinguishes it from reviewed public distribution.
Shopify documents Dev Dashboard app versions, scopes and store installation; apps for a merchant's own store can exchange client credentials for 24-hour access tokens.
Existing admin-created custom apps use installed Admin API access tokens; new admin creation is disabled, token regeneration requires reinstall, and credential rotation requires app replacement.
Shopify access scopes bind authenticated apps to store resources and some sensitive resources require additional provider permission.
